attempts.observed: After the slider round trip: accentHue 258, accent2Hue 78 (exactly opposite). Screen: 'Large preview shows: Two colors: opposites (in use)'. Summary: 'Set by hand, Two colors: opposites'. Decision {kind:'tuned', optionId:'duo-complement'}. After changing the main color to Dark green (152): accent2Hue stays 78; opposite would be 332. Decision optionId becomes null; the screen now shows 'Your design now (in use)'; Summary 'Set by hand, close to “Two colors: opposites”: second color moved toward yellow'. The design and the screen first matched a plain pick of 'opposites' exactly, but unlike a pick the second color stopped following, with no notice on the Main color Step that the second color was left behind. The code documents this as intended ('a hand-tuned Decision is never recomputed'); the owner sees no difference between the two states until the colors drift apart.
